mapper.update: UPDATE favorites SET category_id = #{categoryId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id IN (${ids})
mapper.select: SELECT item_type, COUNT(1) as count FROM favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_available = 1 GROUP BY item_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT f.category_id, c.name as category_name, COUNT(1) as count FROM favorites f LEFT JOIN favorite_categories c ON f.category_id = c.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.is_available = 1 GROUP BY f.category_id, c.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(1) as count FROM favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_available = 1 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date DESC

SELECT
FROM favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_available = 1
AND (
JSON_CONTAINS(tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))
)
ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tags, CONCAT('$[', numbers.n, ']'))) as tag FROM favorites CROSS JOIN ( SELECT 0 as n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 ) numbers WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_available = 1 AND tags IS NOT NULL AND JSON_LENGTH(tags) > numbers.n AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tags, CONCAT('$[', numbers.n, ']'))) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tag
mapper.update: UPDATE favorites SET is_available = #{isAvailable}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id IN (${ids})
mapper.select: SELECT item_type, COUNT(1) as count, ROUND(COUNT(1) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_available = 1), 2) as percentage FROM favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_available = 1 GROUP BY item_type ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN #{field} = 'title' THEN title WHEN #{field} = 'sender_name' THEN sender_name WHEN #{field} = 'source_chat_name' THEN source_chat_name ELSE title END as suggestion FROM favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_available = 1 AND ( CASE WHEN #{field} = 'title' THEN title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') WHEN #{field} = 'sender_name' THEN sender_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') WHEN #{field} = 'source_chat_name' THEN source_chat_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ELSE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') END ) ORDER BY suggestion LIMIT #{limit}
